recommendation: Keep this commit as-is; it is a focused build-scoped consistency fix that completes the already-applied FHIR-48363 semantics without expanding the approved change.
issue_request: FHIR-48363 was Applied/Persuasive and asked to resolve invalid Bundle composition and message search parameters that were typed as reference even though their expressions return embedded resources, by defining a resource search-parameter type, documenting chaining-only semantics for embedded resources, and noting the R5-and-earlier reference-type history.
initial_application: PR #3442, including commit 554d2c28aa585e14e3bbe39a4291c3bfedff0eb3 and merge e38498cfac87086a1eb8b1f6d7ae2c17d96328a9, changed Bundle-composition and Bundle-message to type resource, added the resource code to SearchParamType, updated related type summaries, and added search.html documentation.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-10-21 confirm the 11-0-0 persuasive decision to add a resource search-parameter type and document earlier-version usage. The affected Bundle, SearchParameter, CapabilityStatement, and OperationDefinition sources are active in source/fhir.ini. Current search.html already covers embedded-resource chaining, undefined direct resource parameter tests, and R5-and-earlier reference history.
reconciliation: Updated source/searchparameter/bundle-SearchParameter-search-params.xml so SearchParameter-type lists resource in its description, aligning the SearchParameter resource search-parameter table with the expanded SearchParamType code system and the Bundle resource-typed search parameters.
source_changes: source/searchparameter/bundle-SearchParameter-search-params.xml: added resource to the SearchParameter-type search-parameter description.
